scope: Deterministic fixed feature space, strictly separated leading and tail spectral thresholds
claim: A successful rank-k graph exists iff T(W^T W)^(-1)T^T >= Gamma, when the tail Gram is positive definite.

scope: Deterministic feature space including tail-null directions
claim: The exact projected capacity criterion retains T ker(W); it does not invert a singular tail Gram.

scope: Independent Gaussian starts, d+1 interpolation nodes, node ranks sufficient
claim: Exact k-by-k nodal capacity and a reciprocal-Gram first-moment bound for existence of a successful subspace.

scope: Arbitrary adaptive q-query algorithms on Haar-conjugated symmetric input laws
claim: Output success reduces to an exact capacity event for [V,AV,G_k], of at most 2q+k columns; its adaptive probability law is not bounded here.

scope: Explicit finite q,h,n,k,epsilon conditions; at most q total products, unrestricted innovation count
claim: Success together with at most h innovations has probability at most 1/4 on a fixed hard law. Pointwise 0.99 success forces more than h innovations with probability at least 0.74.

scope: Degree-d full prefix on d+1 tail nodes with Gaussian width B
claim: The pure leading-space dimension is min(k,B,sum_j(B-m_j)_+); if B>=k and (d+1)B>=n, the exact leading space is already in the relaxation.
Actual enlarged span has full/tail ranks 7/7; overgranted degree-3 width-4 prefix has rank 12.

scope: All simultaneous finite n,k,epsilon and arbitrary adaptive two-sided queries
claim: No matching unrestricted all-parameter characterization is asserted.
